summary: Quiet residential kerb under trees; homes 15-16 m away on own side.
reasons: Cars already park along this kerb

drivers.seclusion: Tree-covered verge and houses set back 15-16 m; more homes 14-19 m along the rest of the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked at the kerb, so a van fits beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along this kerb; no signs.

flags: Homes within 25 m on both sides
Overhead power lines along the south kerb
Building site opposite the east end
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by trees from the north and west.

best_section.where: Todd Street south kerb, under the trees west of the building site
